neighboring_unit_entries.title: A uniquely occupied Riemann gas keeps zero microcanonical fluctuations
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Unique factorization permits only one excited configuration at each logarithmic integer energy, giving zero microcanonical state fluctuations while canonical and grand-canonical predictions remain nonzero or divergent, even in the thermodynamic limit; an explicit logarithmic potential addresses realizability.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: The Möbius random walk explains why a strong RH-sufficient bound can fail
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Partial sums of the Möbius function define a walk; the Mertens square-root bound would imply RH but is known to fail at an enormous unknown location, showing both that a sufficient criterion need not be necessary and that vast computation can miss eventual counterexamples.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Escape corrections, response-function inversion, particle-number positivity, phase-transition thresholds, and thermodynamic regularity translate poles or zeros of zeta functions into observable or feasibility constraints.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Experimental agreement can substantiate rather than prove RH, known zero-free regions may merely be recovered, and the strongest thermodynamic conclusion depends on an unproved physical assumption.

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The thermodynamic zero-free argument fails exactly where it assumes, rather than derives, that interactions must change the relevant observables.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: An energy-dependent scattering kernel yields finite positive thermodynamic quantities over a strip; LeClair argues an off-line zeta zero would contradict the assumed interaction effect.
directed.conceptual_reading: Turning zeros into physical feasibility constraints is useful only after the causal interaction premise is independently justified.
directed.representation_or_bridge: A two-body S-matrix kernel maps analytic zeta behavior into density and pressure conditions.
directed.boundary_or_failure: The decisive interaction claim is an assumption, so the contradiction does not constitute a proof of RH.
